items.title: Tim Ries interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 19, 2022
items.q: luckily I’ve known them now for 23 years... they’ve had me back all these years and so it’s been great to have this gig for so long.

ctx.x: Do the Rolling Stones, the core group, do they ever mess up in a concert?

I mean I would — I think they would say yeah but so what — I think that their mess-ups or their little things that happen that are like you know slightly different, they’re okay with that. You know for instance I remember once Keith — Keith has many guitars and he’s got a guitar tech that tunes like for almost every tune has a new guitar because it’s a different tuning. Like not every tune is — so this tune will be that. I remember once he got a guitar and put it on and either he went to the next song or it was…
Do they ever make game time decisions like change their mind about a song list — “Let’s insert this now?”
